name: easyagent-desktop
description: EasyAgent Desktop Client - AI Coding Agent GUI

scripts.electron:build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.electron:build:arm64: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --arm64 --publish never
scripts.electron:build:x64: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --x64 --publish never
scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
